items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I played there with him and we toured all over Denmark

ctx.x: Oh, that's the way it's done. That's the German influence again.
Yes, well he's French but he's livin' over there, so. I made a very nice recording called "Swinging the Blues" with all of these fellows. Then I went to Denmark and I played with John Darville there.
